QuestInfo.name: Building is Hard!
QuestInfo.0: Elex needs more #bmetal#k, in addition to the armor fragments you got him. Ask him for more details.
QuestInfo.1: He wants you to get some #bCursed Plates#k off the #rSinister Steel Masks#k to build the statue. Plates off a mask, huh?
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #b#t4033754##k items from #rSinister Steel Mask#k for Elex. That laugh of his is crawling under your skin...

0.0: I need more materials to complete this statue! A LOT more. Get out there again before I report you! We need more #rmetal#k.
0.1: Those #rSinister Steel Masks#k carry #bMASSIVE#k steel plates. Those things will work just fine!

yes.0: Don't get any funny ideas, I only need them for the statue. No ulterior motives here...

no.0: You're backing out now? What's wrong with you?

item.0: Still not done? Ugh, you're no different from these Perion chumps! I need 25 #b#t4033754##k items from the #rSinister Steel Masks#k!

0.msg: Awesome, this will fetch a pretty pen... Why are you still standing there? Get outta here. I'll make sure everybody knows how much you #rlove the Black Mage#k...

1.msg: What's the money for? Is it for Edelstein?

2.msg: Edel... What? Edelste... What did you say? I have no idea what you're talking about. What's wrong with money, anyway?

3.msg: (Hmm, Elex doesn't know about Edelstein. Maybe he's not the real Elex. Maybe he's part of the dream, one of the creator's pawns.)
